Powerful AI models are already presenting real risks and challenges to our national security, and the federal government is behind the curve. At a time when AI models are progressing exponentially, the Trump Administration has gutted key cybersecurity and technology offices, fired thousands of expert personnel, and failed to provide clear leadership on how to responsibly adopt these novel tools.

It's time for Congress and the Executive Branch to get serious about how to encourage innovation while assuring both government and the public that these systems are safe. We need stronger coordination across the technology sector, government, labor, and other key industries to identify real solutions to guide the responsible adoption of AI.

Artificial intelligence is advancing at an extraordinary pace, and we must slow down its development until we establish commonsense guardrails that ensure this transformational technology is developed safely and responsibly.
 
I’ve worked across the aisle to pass bipartisan legislation establishing safeguards for the federal government’s use of AI, but it’s clear this technology’s impact will be wide-ranging and significant across our entire society. It’s well past time for Congress, the industry, and the Trump Administration to take immediate action and put meaningful standards in place to guide responsible AI innovation.
